header.reason: Won memberships only after Tobi showed which failed renewals in their own file could be recovered. Greg, the controller, then signed. The AE first credited Maya. Front desks stay with Global.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with how much churn is really failed cards.

line.text: AI-powered Smart Retries, card account updater, and cancellation surveys work together to keep revenue flowing

findings.why: Corelane's board churn rose two quarters, and the failed-card share was bigger than anyone expected.
findings.quote: The second bucket was a lot bigger than anyone expected.

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Show the controller recovered renewals in their own numbers.
findings.why: Greg, the controller, sat on the contract two weeks, then signed four days after seeing their own data.
findings.quote: Greg decided whether anybody got chosen.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Answer contract length and the cost of leaving in plain terms.
findings.why: After Global's offer, which the rep only heard about from Maya, questions turned to contract terms and exit costs.
findings.quote: what's the contract term, what does it cost to get out

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Replace 'unified commerce' with plain words about front-desk readers.

line.text: Unify online and in-store commerce: the line between online and in-store has all but disappeared

findings.why: When the rep said 'unified commerce,' Maya, the head of digital, asked whether it just meant the readers.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a customer story of our reader inside studio software.

line.text: Stripe Terminal is a point of sale system that unifies your online and offline channels

findings.why: Maya wanted check-in and sales on one screen, saw only a partner demo, and the front desks stayed with Global.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'members who never meant to leave' instead of 'reduce churn'.

line.text: Monetize faster with Stripe Billing. Manage pricing, reduce churn, and grow revenue on one platform

findings.why: Maya, the head of digital, used this phrase for members lost to failed cards.
findings.quote: members who never meant to leave.
